title: 3v3 Shot-Clock Pressure Game
description: A half-court 3v3 with a short imposed shot clock, forcing decisive decision-making instead of over-passing or holding the ball.

content.objective: Make quick, confident decisions under a short shot clock rather than over-passing or stalling.
content.setup: Three offensive players face three defenders, with a coach counting down a 14-second shot clock out loud.
instructions: Play live 3v3 with the coach counting down from 14 seconds each possession.
A shot must go up before the count reaches zero, or the possession is a turnover.
Teams should look for the best available shot early rather than waiting until the count is critical.
Rotate teams after every four possessions.
coachingPoints: Attack with purpose from the start of the possession, not just at the end.
Communicate the time remaining to teammates.
Take a good available shot rather than forcing a worse one as time runs out.
commonMistakes: Holding the ball too long early, then panicking as the clock runs down.
Forcing a terrible shot right at the buzzer instead of taking an earlier good one.
Ignoring the game's constraint once the pressure is on.
content.safety: Keep contact controlled; call fouls to maintain a fair pace.
